result_text:
The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with zero stock. The fix is one condition in `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`: the query now adds `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the other stock overviews use.

`findStockQuantity` is unchanged, so asking for the quantity of a product with no stock still returns 0. The existing stock tests (`StockTest`, `StockOverviewTest`, `StockPerCategoryTest`, `StockValueTest`) pass with `mvn -q -o test`. I did not add a test for the zero-quantity case or run the full suite.

Nothing is committed.
